chapters.title: Grow a square from every cell
chapters.code:
def maximal_square(matrix):
    m, n, best = len(matrix), len(matrix[0]), 0
    for r in range(m):
        for c in range(n):
            k = 0
            while r + k < m and c + k < n and \
                    all(matrix[r + k][c + j] == "1" for j in range(k + 1)) and \
                    all(matrix[r + i][c + k] == "1" for i in range(k + 1)):
                k += 1
            best = max(best, k)
    return best * best

frames.caption: Bottom-up 2-D table — O(m·n) time, O(m·n) extra space. Input: maximal_square(matrix=[['1', '1', '0'], ['1', '1', '1'], ['0', '1', '1']]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.

chapters.title: One row plus one saved diagonal
chapters.code:
def maximal_square(matrix):
    n = len(matrix[0])
    row, best = [0] * (n + 1), 0
    for line in matrix:
        diag = 0
        for c in range(1, n + 1):
            above = row[c]
            row[c] = 1 + min(row[c], row[c - 1], diag) if line[c - 1] == "1" else 0
            diag = above
            best = max(best, row[c])
    return best * best
